content.title: Chapter 34 - EMERGENCY SERVICES — Sec. 34-73. - Promulgation of rules and regulations.
content.summary:
The chief of police is hereby authorized to adopt rules and regulations not inconsistent
               with this section to aid in its administration and enforcement, pursuant to the procedure
               provided in article V, division 2 of chapter 2 of this Code.

faqs.q: Sec. 34-73. - Promulgation of rules and regulations.
faqs.a:
The chief of police is hereby authorized to adopt rules and regulations not inconsistent
               with this section to aid in its administration and enforcement, pursuant to the procedure
               provided in article V, division 2 of chapter 2 of this Code.
(Code 1981, § 2-191(c); Ord. No. 1745, §§ 2—6, 5-18-1981; Ord. No. 1959, § 1, 8-1-1983;
               Ord. No. 3237, § 2, 12-18-1995)
